verdict.rationale: Twenty documents GraphQL and REST endpoints with auto-generated documentation per workspace, plus an interactive playground, which points toward a generated API description. However, no evidence explicitly says a machine-readable OpenAPI (or equivalent) file can be downloaded, and a probe of common OpenAPI paths on the docs domain returned 404. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger or GraphQL schema file, a confirmed spec URL or download path, independent or hands-on corroboration that the generated docs are machine-readable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
